validation.notes: Repaired the producer/consumer trust boundary in all three modules: resource-loader.loadProjectTrustExtensions now forces setProjectTrusted(false) for the bootstrap pass (it previously forced trusted, so project extensions were resolved before consent); settings-manager.loadFromStorage now honors its projectTrusted argument via `if (scope === "project" && !projectTrusted) return {}` instead of `if (false)`, so untrusted construction/reload never parses project settings; project-trust.resolveProjectTrusted now treats an explicit trustOverride as authoritative when `!== undefined` (previously a falsy `false` fell through to the extension hook, stored decision, default policy and UI prompt). .prale-eval/regression.mjs links the real modules through the read-only subject.mjs harness (only package manager, extension loader, trust store and UI faked) and asserts cross-module observables with uncaught node:assert/strict: (1) inside the resolveProjectTrust callback of a fresh bootstrap the settings manager is still untrusted, effective settings are global-only with global nested compaction values intact, the extension set handed to the resolver contains only cli.ts/global.ts, and every bootstrap resolution logs ('resolve', false, 'global-model'); (2) an explicit false override with an approving UI, a stored 'trusted' decision and an extension hook answering 'yes' still returns false, emits no project_trust extension event and writes nothing to the trust store, while a true override resolves true without events; (3) remembered consent keeps the bootstrap global/CLI-only and lets the later trusted reload admit project.ts alongside cli.ts/global.ts with project overrides winning and global nested values inherited; (4) defaultProjectTrust 'never' keeps project resources out, and SettingsManager is exercised directly across fromStorage({projectTrusted:false}), reload(), setProjectTrusted(true) and setProjectTrusted(false). Mutation check (each file reverted alone to its faulty baseline, then restored) each produced an AssertionError: resource-loader -> 'bootstrap must run with the project untrusted'; settings-manager -> 'bootstrap must read only global settings'; project-trust -> 'an explicit false override must win'. No crashes, import errors or timeouts were used as evidence; asynchronous ordering is controlled only by awaiting the real promise chain (no timers/randomness/network). Test inputs are written under .prale-eval/tmp/regression-work and removed in a finally block. Limitation: the repo's vitest suites cannot run here because node_modules is not installed and dependencies must not be installed; the regression script is the validation artifact.
